tagline: Discord bot for WoW raid attendance management with reverse sign-up
description: RaidPresence uses a reverse sign-up system where all eligible guild members are automatically signed up for raids and must opt-out if they cannot attend — reducing friction and improving attendance visibility.

features.name: Reverse Sign-up System
features.summary: All eligible members are auto-signed-up for raids and opt-out if unavailable, instead of requiring manual sign-ups.
features.landing_copy: Stop chasing sign-ups. Everyone is in by default — players opt out only when they can't make it.

features.name: Full Raid Lifecycle
features.summary: Create, edit, clone, close, cancel, and delete raids with a single command.
features.landing_copy: Complete raid management from creation to archive — one command handles it all.

features.name: Attendance & Reliability Tracking
features.summary: Track player attendance history, reliability metrics, and opt-out patterns across raids.
features.landing_copy: Know who shows up. Attendance history and reliability scores help you plan with confidence.

features.name: Raid Composition Analysis
features.summary: Analyze raid composition by role (tank, healer, melee DPS, ranged DPS) with optimization suggestions.
features.landing_copy: See your comp at a glance — tanks, healers, melee, and ranged with smart suggestions.

features.name: Raid Reminders
features.summary: Send manual reminders to all signed-up players for an upcoming raid.
features.landing_copy: One command pings everyone who's signed up — no one forgets raid night.

features.name: Raid Archiving
features.summary: Archive completed raids to a dedicated channel, with search across archived raids by name, player, or date.
features.landing_copy: Completed raids move to your archive channel automatically. Search past raids anytime.

features.name: Auto-Archive
features.summary: Automatically archive closed raids 2 hours after their scheduled time.
features.landing_copy: Set it and forget it — closed raids archive themselves after the run.

features.name: Raid Status Dashboard
features.summary: View a dashboard of all upcoming raids with roster counts and status.
features.landing_copy: See every upcoming raid, who's in, and who's out — all in one view.

features.name: Roster Refresh
features.summary: Refresh raid rosters when guild membership changes — new members are added, departed members removed.
features.landing_copy: Guild roster changed? One command syncs every upcoming raid.

features.name: Multi-language Support
features.summary: Bot messages available in English and German, configurable per server.
features.landing_copy: English or German — your server, your language.

features.name: Per-Raid Role Selection
features.summary: Specify which Discord roles are eligible for each raid at creation time, giving flexibility for different raid groups.
features.landing_copy: Different raids, different rosters. Pick which roles join each event.

features.name: Role Composition Slots
features.summary: Define tank, healer, and DPS slot counts per raid (e.g., '2T 4H 14D') for composition tracking.
features.landing_copy: Set your comp targets — 2 tanks, 4 healers, 14 DPS — and track against them.

features.name: Role-Based Character Preferences
features.summary: Players in multiple raid groups can maintain different class/spec preferences per Discord role, with automatic fallback to global preferences.
features.landing_copy: Run two raid groups? Your main can be a healer in one and DPS in the other — preferences follow the role, not the player.

features.name: Setup Wizard
features.summary: Interactive setup wizard for initial server configuration — roles, timezone, language, and archive channel.
features.landing_copy: Get running in under a minute with the guided setup wizard.

commands_summary.name: /raid
commands_summary.description: Raid lifecycle and archiving — create, list, delete, close, open, cancel, remind, refresh, edit, clone, archive, unarchive, search

commands_summary.name: /stats
commands_summary.description: Statistics and analytics — raid, guild, status, attendance, suggest

commands_summary.name: /config
commands_summary.description: Server configuration — view, leader roles, timezone, language, archive channel, auto-archive
